feature_name: Fine-tuned custom extractor processor version upgrade
summary: This preview feature lets you upgrade a fine-tuned custom extractor processor to a newer base version while preserving the previous configuration.
extended_definition: This preview feature lets you upgrade a fine-tuned custom extractor processor to a newer base version while preserving the previous configuration.
